note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: RSMeM design: domain knowledge plus failure-aware experience yields accuracy gains

nodes.name: RS agents are domain-agnostic
nodes.description: Remote-sensing agents built on general-purpose LLMs are domain-agnostic, so they struggle with concepts like NDVI, BSI or land-surface temperature, producing brittle tool-use trajectories with cascading errors such as premature termination or wrong tool invocation.

nodes.name: Workflow templates are costly and static
nodes.description: Expert-authored workflow templates are labor-intensive to build and maintain and act as external references rather than letting agents internalize corrections from execution failures.

nodes.name: Reflection alone is limited in geoscience
nodes.description: Without domain knowledge, reflecting agents often misdiagnose failures and fail to turn errors into reusable experience.

nodes.name: Hierarchical knowledge base
nodes.description: The expert-curated knowledge base has a three-level hierarchy of 3 geoscience domains, 12 sub-domains and 64 atomic analytical tasks, each encoded as a Task Card (title, definition, suggestion).

nodes.name: Hierarchical Knowledge Grounding
nodes.description: Stream A retrieves the top-1 Task Card by combining sentence-embedding cosine similarity with lexical bonuses for task title, domain keywords and card content (alpha=0.2, beta=0.08, gamma=0.1, threshold 0.2), compensating for geoscience terms underrepresented in embeddings.

nodes.name: Symbolic failure critic
nodes.description: A label-free symbolic critic flags failed trajectories using heuristic rules: missing or malformed answer tags, empty responses, invalid option letters, refusal or incompleteness signals, and hedging language indicating guessing.

nodes.name: Failure-Aware Memory retrieval
nodes.description: Reflections distilled from failed tool-use traces are stored per instance and the most recent one is retrieved by instance-indexed lookup in the next round, giving precise negative constraints and historical fixes.

nodes.name: RSMeM improves tool use
nodes.description: On EarthBench, RSMeM consistently improves Any-Order, In-Order, Exact-Match and Wise-Score tool-use metrics across backbones, including DeepSeek-V3.2, Kimi-K2 and Qwen3-8B.

nodes.name: Accuracy gain with tiny token cost
nodes.description: RSMeM raises DeepSeek-V3.2 accuracy by 6.07 points (to 57.89%) while token overhead rises only from 6.23% to 6.97%.

nodes.name: HKG and FAR are complementary
nodes.description: HKG mainly improves planning (on DeepSeek-V3.2, AO 77.27%->79.50%, IO 55.02%->56.51%), while FAR mainly improves trajectory robustness (Wise-Score 0.0408->0.0763 on Qwen3-8B); the full system peaks at 42.11% on Qwen3-8B and 57.89% on DeepSeek-V3.2.

nodes.name: Memory evolution raises density
nodes.description: Across evolution stages on DeepSeek-V3.2, EM rises from 25.85% to 27.01% and Experience Density from 55.72 to 57.69, indicating distillation into more concentrated corrective knowledge.

nodes.name: Structured grounding beats generic retrieval
nodes.description: RSMeM outperforms flat embedding retrieval (+16.33 pp accuracy over Simple RAG) and the Reflexion reflection-only baseline across four backbones.

nodes.name: Cascading semantic error case
nodes.description: In a Landsat thermal case, treating brightness temperature BT10 as land-surface temperature derailed downstream steps; refinement distilled a semantic constraint (LST must be emissivity-aware) and a procedural constraint requiring a complete consistent pipeline.

isolated_nodes.name: Stronger backbones benefit more
isolated_nodes.description: Stronger backbones benefit more from RSMeM because they better summarize domain knowledge and diagnose execution errors.

isolated_nodes.name: Gains vary by domain
isolated_nodes.description: RSMeM benefits most in domains with standardized multi-step workflows, e.g. Disaster Management (+10.25 pp), with smaller gains where residual errors stem from other sources.

isolated_nodes.name: Trajectories stay efficient
isolated_nodes.description: Trajectory Redundancy Index values remain close to 1.0, so gains come from refined planning rather than longer trajectories.

structural_reasoning: Motivating limitations feed the knowledge base and failure-memory design; the two streams jointly explain the measured tool-use, accuracy, efficiency, and ablation results.
